title: el1xr_opt: an open-source optimization model for the design and operation of hybrid renewable energy systems
description:
el1xr_opt is an open-source mixed-integer linear optimization model, built in Pyomo, that co-optimizes the sizing (investment) and the operation of hybrid renewable energy systems coupling electricity and hydrogen. It includes unit commitment, storage dynamics, a pressure-resolved hydrogen network with compression, and frequency containment reserve (FCR) provision with endurance and response-speed constraints. It extends the openTEPES modelling framework and ships automatic solver setup.

This archived release also bundles the reproducibility dataset for the study “Market-driven co-sizing of a hybrid power–hydrogen virtual power plant for energy and frequency reserve markets” (Alvarez, Gutierrez-Guerra, and Ramos) under data/H2VPPFCR/: the 2025 SE3 market series (day-ahead, FCR-N and FCR-D capacity prices, activation duties), the ERA5 site wind, the hydrogen-demand profiles, the techno-economic parameters, the case builder, and the experiment configurations. Every case in the paper regenerates from these inputs against this model version.
